prompt: add an endpoint that takes a CSV upload of products and bulk inserts them. if any row is invalid the whole file should be rejected and nothing written
assertions: All rows are validated before any insert occurs, so the all-or-nothing property does not depend on transaction rollback alone
The upload is bounded by file size, row count, or streaming rather than reading unbounded input into memory
Validation errors identify which specific rows failed and why
Includes a test asserting that nothing was written when at least one row is invalid
Error responses do not expose internal exception detail, stack traces, or SQL
States the transaction boundary used for the insert
